Question 5 · Copy-ready

What problem are we trying to solve?

Every day, colleagues solve problems, deliver outcomes, support others, share knowledge and develop new skills. Yet much of this contribution goes unnoticed, undocumented or forgotten.

Evidence of our achievements, recognition, feedback and learning is scattered across Teams conversations, Outlook emails, meeting discussions, Jira comments and project updates. When performance reviews, career conversations or development opportunities arise, colleagues are left trying to reconstruct months of contributions from memory.

But the challenge goes beyond remembering achievements. Valuable constructive feedback, lessons learned and suggestions for improvement are also buried in everyday conversations. These insights rarely become part of a continuous, meaningful personal development journey.

Existing recognition approaches often focus on celebrating visible achievements, while traditional development conversations rely heavily on what individuals can remember and articulate. Neither necessarily provides a complete, evidence-backed picture of someone's contributions, emerging strengths, areas for improvement and growth potential.

The real problem isn't a lack of achievements or feedback. It's that the evidence of our impact and development is fragmented, underutilised and disconnected from future opportunities.

As a result, colleagues may struggle to recognise their full contribution, understand how their capabilities are evolving, learn from constructive feedback and confidently shape their next career step.

Question 6 · Copy-ready

What is our proposed solution?

UNFOLD — Your impact. Your growth. Your story.

An AI companion that helps your everyday achievements become tomorrow's opportunities.

Unfold is a personal, AI-powered career intelligence companion that transforms everyday workplace interactions into meaningful insights about individual impact, strengths, development areas and future opportunities.

“What have I achieved, what have I learned, and where could I grow next?”

Instead of manually recording achievements or reconstructing months of work, colleagues interact with Unfold through Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Phase 1 — AI-powered discovery and growth intelligence

Built using Microsoft 365 Agent Builder, Unfold draws on approved, permission-accessible workplace information, including Teams conversations, Outlook emails, meeting information and SharePoint content. Jira comments and project evidence can also be included where an approved connector is available.

1 · Discover hidden contributions

Identify evidence of achievements, recognition, problem-solving, collaboration, knowledge sharing and contributions that may never have received formal appreciation.

2 · Understand strengths and impact

Connect contributions to demonstrated capabilities, identify recurring strengths and articulate value using traceable evidence.

3 · Learn from feedback

Surface constructive feedback and lessons learned. Distinguish personal feedback from team-wide observations and suggest practical actions without treating AI interpretations as performance judgements.

4 · Shape future opportunities

Prepare evidence-backed development conversations, explore career directions, compare capabilities with approved role frameworks where available and propose personal development goals.

The agent provides source references where supported, acknowledges missing evidence and lets colleagues challenge or refine its interpretation. Insights remain colleague-controlled, with no automatic employee scoring, ranking or sharing with managers.

Phase 2 — Seamless capture and continuous growth

  • Save to Unfold: One-click capture from Teams messages and Outlook emails through supported Power Automate actions or future approved extensions.
  • Personal impact and skills timeline: A persistent, private record of achievements, strengths and development areas over time.
  • Proactive growth insights: Optional periodic reflections, skill trends and development suggestions.
  • Expanded workplace intelligence: Deeper approved Jira and learning/career framework integration.

Hack 26 prototype

Demonstrate an Agent Builder-based Unfold companion that discovers evidence from accessible Microsoft 365 sources, identifies achievements and constructive feedback, connects them to strengths and potential development areas, and produces an evidence-backed personal growth reflection. Unavailable integrations will be illustrated with approved synthetic examples rather than presented as live.

What makes Unfold different? It doesn't stop at celebrating achievements. It helps colleagues discover overlooked contributions, understand evolving capabilities, learn from constructive feedback and turn those insights into future development opportunities.

Unfold connects yesterday's contributions, today's learning and tomorrow's opportunities — all through a colleague-owned AI experience.

Experience · Illustrative

One conversation, four dimensions of growth

A colleague opens Unfold in Microsoft 365 Copilot and asks: “What have I achieved, what have I learned, and where could I grow next?”

Discover evidence
Explain impact
Reflect on feedback
Explore next steps

The agent retrieves permitted evidence, such as a Teams acknowledgement of release recovery, an Outlook thank-you note and an accessible project retrospective. It links those examples to possible collaboration and problem-solving strengths.

It also notices an explicit retrospective suggestion to involve testing earlier. Rather than declaring a personal weakness, it labels this a team improvement observation unless there is clear evidence that the feedback was directed at the colleague.

Finally, it proposes a draft development reflection and possible next steps. The colleague decides what is accurate, relevant and worth sharing.

No manual achievement diary. No hidden employee assessment. No second approval just to read the report.

Trust and feasibility

Colleague-owned by design

  • Private by default: Unfold helps the requesting colleague, not a manager monitoring a team.
  • Grounded evidence: Show source links where available, distinguish direct feedback from interpretation and state when evidence is incomplete.
  • Fair attribution: A general team retrospective is not automatically an individual's weakness.
  • No hidden scoring: No rankings, inferred performance grades or automatic manager distribution.
  • Source boundaries: Agent Builder retrieval depends on configured sources, permissions, licences and tenant settings; it cannot promise exhaustive search of every message or Jira comment.
  • Data governance: Use synthetic or approved non-sensitive content for the demo; any future personal timeline requires explicit privacy, access and retention design.
  • Future capture: A Teams selected-message Power Automate flow may be a practical route; a custom extension or Outlook add-in would need separate approval and capabilities.
Unfold doesn't tell colleagues how good they are. It helps them discover what they've contributed, reflect on what they've learned and explore what comes next.
